messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- As of 2025-09-15, the reporting service no longer depends on the ledger; it reads from the event bus instead. [valid 2025-09-15 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-09-15]
    earlier: The reporting service depends on the ledger. [valid 2025-04-08 to 2025-09-15; recorded by standup/dune/2025-04-08]
- The webhook dispatcher needs the event bus to work. [valid 2026-02-04 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-02-04-2]
- On 2025-06-27, Team Boreal observed that the event bus's request volume halved following the client rollout, and flagged it since the event bus is not Team Boreal's service. [valid 2025-06-27 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-06-27]
- On 2025-07-03, Team Cinder observed that the event bus's CPU sat at 90 percent following the traffic shift, and flagged it since the event bus is not Team Cinder's service. [valid 2025-07-03 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-07-03]
- Team Dune has switched to a monthly game day. [decision; valid 2025-05-09 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-05-09-2]
- As of 2025-11-20, the event bus is owned by Team Boreal; Team Cinder kept it until then. [valid 2025-11-20 to now; recorded by handover/2025-11-20-event-bus]
    earlier: As of 2025-08-26, the event bus is owned by Team Cinder; Team Atlas kept it until then. [valid 2025-08-26 to 2025-11-20; recorded by handover/2025-08-26-event-bus]
    earlier: The event bus is owned by Team Atlas. [valid 2025-04-03 to 2025-08-26; recorded by handover/2025-04-03-event-bus]
    earlier: The event bus is owned by Team Boreal. [valid 2025-01-09 to 2025-04-03; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-01-09]
- As of 2025-11-20, the event bus is a Team Boreal service; Team Cinder kept it until then. [valid 2025-11-20 to now; recorded by handover/2025-11-20-event-bus]
    earlier: As of 2025-08-26, the event bus is a Team Cinder service; Team Atlas kept it until then. [valid 2025-08-26 to 2025-11-20; recorded by handover/2025-08-26-event-bus]
    earlier: As of 2025-04-03, the event bus is a Team Atlas service. [valid 2025-04-03 to 2025-08-26; recorded by handover/2025-04-03-event-bus]
    earlier: As of 2025-03-31, the event bus remains a Team Boreal service. [valid 2025-03-31 to 2025-04-03; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-03-31]
- The notifier depends on the event bus for delivery events. [valid 2025-01-17 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-01-17]
- As of 2026-05-25, Team Atlas has switched to a no-deploy Friday. [decision; valid 2026-05-25 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-05-25-2]
- The webhooks service depends on the event bus for outbound events. [valid 2025-01-17 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-01-17]
- The event bus deploys on Tuesdays and Thursdays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2025-02-21 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-02-21]
- On 2025-11-20, Team Boreal took over the event bus from Team Cinder. [valid 2025-11-20 to now; recorded by handover/2025-11-20-event-bus]
- On 2025-09-15, Team Dune decided that the reporting service will read from the event bus instead of querying the ledger directly because the nightly ledger scans were blocking billing runs. [decision; valid 2025-09-15 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-09-15]
- As of 2025-11-20, dashboards and alerts for the event bus are being repointed. [valid 2025-11-20 to now; recorded by handover/2025-11-20-event-bus]
- As of 2025-10-27, the scheduler deploys on weekday mornings before 11:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2025-10-27 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-10-27-2]
    earlier: The scheduler deploys on weekdays after 15:00 UTC and at no other time. [constraint; valid 2025-03-19 to 2025-10-27; recorded by standup/ember/2025-03-19]
- As of 2025-11-07, the reporting service moved from Team Dune to the Ember team. [valid 2025-11-17 to now; recorded by handover/2025-11-17-reporting-correction]
    earlier: As of 2025-11-07, the reporting service moved from Team Dune to Team Boreal. [valid 2025-11-07 to 2025-11-17; recorded by handover/2025-11-07-reporting]
    earlier: Team Dune owns the reporting service. [valid 2025-01-20 to 2025-11-07; recorded by standup/dune/2025-01-20-2]
- As of 2026-02-23, the scheduler's deploy window remains weekday mornings before 11:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2026-02-23 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-02-23]
- On 2025-11-07, Farah walked Marcus through the reporting service runbook. [valid 2025-11-07 to now; recorded by handover/2025-11-07-reporting]
- On 2026-05-04, Team Boreal decided that the event bus will retain messages for seven days because replaying a full week has covered every incident recovery so far. [decision; valid 2026-05-04 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-05-04]

Question: What did reporting depend on before it switched to the event-bus?

message.reasoning:
The question asks what the reporting service depended on before it switched to the event bus. Memory says: "As of 2025-09-15, the reporting service no longer depends on the ledger; it reads from the event bus instead." Earlier: "The reporting service depends on the ledger." Also "Team Dune decided that the reporting service will read from the event bus instead of querying the ledger directly because the nightly ledger scans were blocking billing runs."

So the answer: the ledger.
